visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an outdoor courtyard with a large inflatable yellow and white cat wearing a red hat positioned in front of a white building with brown shutters. Green foliage and a blooming flower wall are visible to the left. (2) The camera moves to a different outdoor section featuring lush green bushes and trees surrounding a white arched walkway. (3) Close-up shots show various cat-themed outdoor decorations, including a cat character resting on a large green leaf and a row of diverse cartoon cat cutouts on a red platform under red umbrellas. (4) Transitioning indoors, the environment shifts to a bright retail space with wooden shelving and white walls. A man's hand holds up merchandise like a green tote bag with cat illustrations and a small round cat badge. (5) The visual focus moves to a cafe setting with cat-themed food items displayed on glass shelves and white counters. Close-ups feature pancakes with cat faces branded on them, a green crumble dessert, and a bright green slushie with a cat-topped stirrer. (6) A man with glasses is shown taking a bite of a pancake, followed by detailed shots of the green dessert and slushie. (7) The final sequence returns to the outdoor giant cat inflatable under bright sunlight, framed by green trees and a white wall.
